summary.text: Debo Powers is a Democratic state representative from Montana who has represented House District 3 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former public school teacher and principal, she previously served in the House from 2019 to 2021 and sits on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Debo Powers was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and graduated from W.J. Woodham High School.
She studied at Pensacola Community College and Florida State University, and her career experience includes working as a public school teacher and principal.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in a military family, now lives in rural Montana next to Glacier National Park, and has worked as a conservation and public lands advocate and a volunteer for Glacier National Park wilderness patrol and the Flathead National Forest as a fire lookout.
Powers was appointed to House District 3 in 2019 and served until January 2021, after losing the November 3, 2020 general election to Republican Braxton Mitchell.
She defeated Cathy Mitchell in the November 5, 2024 general election and returned to the House on January 6, 2025, where she is assigned to the Appropriations Committee.

Her stated key campaign messages in the 2024 survey were protecting public lands, changing the state funding formula for public schools to fund education adequately and raise teacher pay, and affordability, including lower residential property taxes and affordable housing.
